profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack
profile.summary:
I'm a software developer and technical leader with over 6 years of experience building and modernizing web applications across full stack, cloud, and low code platforms. I specialize in delivering maintainable solutions using C#, Angular, PostgreSQL, and AWS, with deep experience in OutSystems development and legacy system modernization. More recently, I've been building AI-powered applications and internal tools using Python, FastAPI, and NextJS.

I stay closely connected to the evolving AI landscape, actively working with current tools and protocols to build practical applications. I've developed custom AI skills and several production applications that solve real business problems, combining technical implementation with an understanding of how these tools fit into larger workflows.

Outside of full time roles, I co-founded Wescot Solutions, a small consultancy helping businesses grow through custom websites, SEO, branding, and ad strategy. I lead the technical side, manage contractors, and build internal tools and automations that keep everything running smoothly. This work has given me a proven development and marketing workflow that connects technical execution to measurable business outcomes.

Known for being adaptable, self-driven, and resourceful, I'm excited by opportunities in development, technical leadership, or management that value autonomy, creative problem solving, and meaningful impact.

Always open to connect or chat!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and building an agentic RAG chatbot solution for a TomorrowToday client using Python, LangChain, Chainlit, and OpenAI that delivers real time insights to the client's projects with dynamic knowledge retrieval.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · OpenAI API · Next.js · Software Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Rebuilt legacy OutSystems application into a modern, scalable web platform using C#, Angular, PostgreSQL, and AWS, improving maintainability and security.
● Designed and implemented RESTful APIs to integrate data sources and services, increasing efficient data exchange.
● Contributed to Agile delivery cycles, collaborating in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and client demos to ensure timely feature releases.
● Supported environments, coordinated deployments, and collaborated with team members on strategy and technical implementation decisions.
● Modernized legacy virus scanning process by implementing an AWS based solution (Lambda, S3, SQS) for file quarantine and distribution, eliminating Windows container overhead and reducing file processing time.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · C# · AngularJS · PostgreSQL · OutSystems

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description:
● Delivered enterprise grade applications in OutSystems to support global non-profit healthcare ops, achieving uninterrupted uptime and robust data integrity.
● Led data migrations to new platforms, ensuring uninterrupted access for HR and finance users.
● Created and maintained comprehensive technical documentation for system configurations and user workflows, enabling faster onboarding and consistent deployment practices.
● Administered Jira and Confluence for HR and Finance, improved process and reduced support requests by 40%.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
● Translated stakeholder needs into actionable user stories, specs, and detailed testing plans.
● Documented development lifecycle and release processes across multiple projects.
● Researched, interviewed, and maintained relationships with software vendors and contractors.

positions.title: Police Officer
positions.description:
● Developed leadership, crisis decision making, and communication skills in high pressure field environments. Skills which are directly transferable to fast paced software delivery teams.
● Recognized for exceptional problem solving skills, clear communication, and calm under pressure.

positions.title: Engineer Technician
positions.description:
● Developed and implemented quality control procedures, product testing, product database, and user documentation
● Designed electrical schematics for air conditioning units using Adobe Illustrator
● Worked within research and development to create custom components - starting from CAD drawings and finishing with a solution to satisfy customer needs
● Provided remote and on-site service to priority clients (Boeing, Lockheed Martin, ViaSat)
